head.label: About
head.title: We look at the small ones
head.lead: Smallfold finds sponsors for small YouTube channels, with a person choosing each one by hand.

story.label: Our story
story.title: It began with a small channel
paragraphs: Smallfold was started by a YouTube creator with a small channel who found that sponsors only looked at big ones.
That finding is why Smallfold exists. Today we find sponsors for small YouTube channels.

items.title: A person should choose
items.text: A sponsor should be chosen by someone who has looked at the channel. So a person does it, with no automatic list and no algorithm.

items.title: Small channels deserve attention
items.text: We work only with channels of 1,000 to 50,000 subscribers.

items.title: The decision belongs to you
items.text: It is your channel. You can turn down any sponsor we suggest, and nothing goes ahead without your yes.

platforms.label: Platforms
platforms.title: YouTube now, other platforms later
platforms.text: Today we work with YouTube channels only. Other platforms will come later.
